title: Momoi Airi — Airi's Beauty Salon〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: The Lumina Forum - Bedroom

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori! Shizuku! It's morning! Wake up!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mhm...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Yawn*
Is something wrong, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
“Is something wrong”? Don't give me that!
We're going to school this morning!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Remember how we talked about leaving here a bit early because it's kinda far?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right...
Thank you for waking me, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You too, Minori! You won't have time to eat breakfast if you don't get up soon.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Mhm... Okay, Mom...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I am not your mother!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. It sounds like she's still half asleep.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Honestly... Wait, Minori, your hair's a total mess!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh my... You look like a hedgehog.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Lemme guess. You fell asleep without drying your hair properly, didn't you?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I saw her looking at her phone pretty late last night...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... I wanted to know what everyone was saying about the grand prix...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Knowing what people are saying is important, but that all goes to waste if you catch a cold or something. So, you gotta be more careful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Anyway, where's my hairbrush...?
Oh, here it is...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? No, this is my toothbrush...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You leave me no choice...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Come over here. I'll fix your hair for you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Today's a special exception. We're all gonna be late if we don't do something about this right now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go!
It's time for some Happy Brushing!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I feel like I'm Samo...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. You look so comfortable, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, your hair's starting to look much better...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I'm gonna need a dryer to fully fix this. Lemme spritz your hair with this primer, and...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're pretty good at this, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's because I do this all the time for my little sister.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really?
You always do her hair? She's so lucky.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Enough of that. Close your eyes for me while I dry your hair.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, I'm finished!
What do you think?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...! I don't believe it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
This is amazing, Airi!
You did a way better job than I've ever done!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Heehee. It was a piece of cake.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I know I'm gonna have a really happy day now because you did my hair!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm so glad for you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But I'm also a little jealous.
Would you mind doing my hair as well, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, I'd like to ask the same.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Wait, you already did your hair.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah...
But opportunities like this hardly ever come up.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Please, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, fine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Come over here!
I'll work on both of you at the same time!
